def pack(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u32:
    if length(s) < 35 or length(s) > 1048576 or uint(s, 0, 8) != 3559651738044813896:
        return 4294967295
    count = length(s) - 32
    remaining = count
    n0 = uint(s, 8, 8)
    if n0 == 0 or n0 > remaining:
        return 4294967295
    remaining = remaining - n0
    n1 = uint(s, 16, 8)
    if n1 == 0 or n1 > remaining:
        return 4294967295
    remaining = remaining - n1
    n2 = uint(s, 24, 8)
    if n2 == 0 or n2 > remaining:
        return 4294967295
    remaining = remaining - n2
    if remaining != 0:
        return 4294967295
    size = count + 5382
    if size > 1048576 or length(o) < size:
        return 4294967294
    prefix_0(o)
    prefix_1(o)
    prefix_2(o)
    prefix_3(o)
    prefix_4(o)
    prefix_5(o)
    prefix_6(o)
    prefix_7(o)
    write(o, 96, size, 8)
    write(o, 104, size, 8)
    position = 5382
    write(o, 587, position - 591, 4)
    position = position + n0
    write(o, 1389, position - 1393, 4)
    position = position + n1
    write(o, 2503, position - 2507, 4)
    position = position + n2
    copy_bytes(s, o, 32, 5382, count)
    return size

def prefix_7(o:mutbuf) -> u64:
    write(o, 5376, 214797175767389, 6)
    return 0

def uint(s:readbuf, at:u64, size:u64) -> u64:
    value = 0
    i = 0
    while i < size:
        value = value | (byte(s, at + i) << (i * 8))
        i = i + 1
    return value

def get(w:mutbuf, at:u64) -> u64:
    value = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        value = value | (byte(w, at + i) << (i * 8))
        i = i + 1
    return value

def write(o:mutbuf, at:u64, value:u64, size:u64) -> u64:
    i = 0
    while i < size:
        store(o, at + i, (value >> (i * 8)) & 255)
        i = i + 1
    return 0

def put(w:mutbuf, at:u64, value:u64) -> u64:
    return write(w, at, value, 8)

def copy_bytes(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, source:u64, target:u64, size:u64) -> u64:
    i = 0
    while i < size:
        store(o, target + i, byte(s, source + i))
        i = i + 1
    return 0
